P24 · Base/Born matched-loss response

Frozen single p50 contact; fixed-gain PCM, native geometry, Born elastic law, 6 kHz physics, 3 ms pulse, 75 ms recovery and ×50 damping baseline. Columns show flat control, frequency loss and frequency − flat. No per-clip normalization. STFT uses the existing 1024 Hann / 256 hop renderer at fixed −100…0 dBFS. ERB panels aggregate linear STFT power before 10 log10; they are an ERB-binned STFT sidecar, not gammatone or cochleogram output. Difference panels display ±24 dB; metrics retain unclipped values.

STFT time axis is 279 left-aligned frames at 5.333 ms hop over the 1.5 s render. Frequency bins are 46.875 Hz apart; the last displayed bin is 7,968.75 Hz. ERB centers and boundaries are in analysis.json. The loss comparison and field modal curves are in the machine-readable report.
